purpose: Fifty non-identifying, non-scripted conversation domains for semantically controlled duplex call synthesis. Each seed must yield twenty genuinely distinct scenarios and ten interaction trajectories per scenario.

seeds.focus: apologies, boundaries, misunderstandings, and gradual trust repair

seeds.title: Neighbors and shared spaces

interactionRequirements.controlFrameRule: Every generated agent target turn receives a declarative, target-free control frame. Selected counterfactual pairs hold caller context fixed while facts, tool result, policy constraint, caller posture, or next goal change materially.
